title: Downtown Riverfront View with Pool!
description:
Riverfront Condos is a unique complex with exclusive riverfront views!  Extremely friendly for short-term renters.  Perfect for out of town guests on vacation or locals for the "downtown" experience.  Excellent for folks in town for business.  Swimming pool, grill, firepit, gym, & laundry access for all guests! Firestick provided for TV (no traditional cable). Rates are non-negotiable.

The space
Short walk to Broadway but still secluded from tourists! A few blocks from Nashville Sounds Stadium, Brooklyn Bowl, and many other attractions.

Guest access
Swimming pool (April 1 - Oct 31), gym, laundry facilities, firepit, patio & deck with grill.

Other things to note
The couch is not a sleeper sofa but if comfy to sleep on! Fully furnished kitchen with Keurig single cup maker.
